application_fee: Fee can be paid through Online Payment Gateway only, using Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking. No other mode of payment will be accepted. Examination and processing fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.
selection_process: Computer Based Test (CBT): Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of merit order in the CBT/OMR screening test of 120 marks conducted by the Aayog. No personal interview will be held. || Merit List & Waiting Panel: A category-wise merit list will be prepared based on marks secured in the CBT. In case of a tie, the merit will be determined on the basis of marks obtained in the essential qualification, then by age (senior preferred), and then alphabetically. A waiting panel shall also be prepared: up to 25 advertised posts - 25%; between 25 to 50 posts - 15%; above 50 posts - 10%, subject to minimum numbers. The waiting panel is valid for one year from the date of sending recommendation to the appointing authority. || Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates as per merit will be called for document verification. Candidates must produce all original certificates/documents and self-attested photocopies. The downloaded/printed copy of the online application form along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies must be produced at the time of document verification. No Offline Application Form will be accepted. || Final Recommendation: After document verification, the Aayog will recommend candidates to the appointing authority. Recommendations of the Aayog will be valid till the appointments are offered to the candidates by the Appointing Authority. || Counseling/Allocation: After selection, allocation of schools/posts will be done through merit-based counseling as per Government guidelines.
